segments.text: The mighty God, even the LORD, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.
Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.
Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.
He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.
And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God is judge himself. Selah.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I am God, even thy God.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, to have been continually before me.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he goats out of thy folds.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field are mine.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.
But unto the wicked God saith,

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother’s son.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God.
